# Game Idea: Neon Escape

A top‑down HTML canvas game where the player pilots a small ship through an endless stream of rotating neon obstacles. Arrow keys steer the ship; collect power‑ups to briefly slow obstacles. **Lose condition:** collision with any obstacle or the timer reaching zero.

1: // Simple Neon Escape game with enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   // Load sounds
5:   const sounds = {
6:     // Simple beep for power‑up (replace with your own file if desired)
7:     powerUp: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YUQAAAAB'),
8:     // Collision sound
9:     collision: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YUQAAAAB')
10:   };
11: 
12:   // handle high‑DPI screens
13:   const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
14:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
15:   if (!canvas) return;
16:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
17:   // set canvas size to match CSS size * dpr
18:   const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
19:   canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
20:   canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
21:   ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
22:   const width = canvas.width / dpr;
23:   const height = canvas.height / dpr;
24: 
25: 
26:   // Ship
27:   const ship = {
28:     x: width / 2,
29:     y: height - 40,
30:     size: 20,
31:     vx: 0,
32:     vy: 0,
33:     speed: 3,
34:     draw() {
35:       ctx.save();
36:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
37:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
38:       ctx.beginPath();
39:       ctx.moveTo(0, -this.size);
40:       ctx.lineTo(this.size / 2, this.size);
41:       ctx.lineTo(-this.size / 2, this.size);
42:       ctx.closePath();
43:       ctx.fill();
44:       ctx.restore();
45:     },
46:     update() {
47:       this.x = Math.max(this.size, Math.min(width - this.size, this.x + this.vx));
48:       this.y = Math.max(this.size, Math.min(height - this.size, this.y + this.vy));
49:     }
50:   };
51: 
52:   // Obstacles
53:   const obstacles = [];
54:   const obstacleFreq = 1500; // ms
55:   const obstacleSize = 40;
56:   function spawnObstacle() {
57:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
58:     const radius = Math.max(width, height);
59:     const x = width / 2 + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
60:     const y = height / 2 + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
61:     const dir = Math.atan2(height / 2 - y, width / 2 - x);
62:     obstacles.push({x, y, angle: 0, speed: 1.5, dir, size: obstacleSize});
63:   }
64: 
65:   // Power‑up to slow obstacles for 3 seconds
66:   let slowTimer = 0;
67:   const powerUps = [];
68:   const powerUpFreq = 10000;
69:   function spawnPowerUp() {
70:     const x = Math.random() * (width - 40) + 20;
71:     const y = Math.random() * (height - 40) + 20;
72:     powerUps.push({x, y, size: 12, active: true});
73:   }
74: 
75:   // Timer
76:   let timeLeft = 30; // seconds
77:   let lastTime = performance.now();
78: 
79:   // Input handling
80:   const keys = {};
81:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {keys[e.key] = true;});
82:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {keys[e.key] = false;});
83: 
84:   function update(dt) {
85:     // ship controls
86:     ship.vx = (keys.ArrowLeft ? -1 : 0) + (keys.ArrowRight ? 1 : 0);
87:     ship.vy = (keys.ArrowUp ? -1 : 0) + (keys.ArrowDown ? 1 : 0);
88:     ship.vx *= ship.speed;
89:     ship.vy *= ship.speed;
90:     ship.update();
91: 
92:     // obstacles movement
93:     const obstacleSpeedFactor = slowTimer > 0 ? 0.3 : 1;
94:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
95:       o.x += Math.cos(o.dir) * o.speed * obstacleSpeedFactor;
96:       o.y += Math.sin(o.dir) * o.speed * obstacleSpeedFactor;
97:       o.angle += 0.03;
98:     });
99:     // remove off‑screen obstacles
100:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
101:       const o = obstacles[i];
102:       if (o.x < -o.size || o.x > width + o.size || o.y < -o.size || o.y > height + o.size) {
103:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
104:       }
105:     }
106: 
107:     // power‑up collection
108:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
109:       const p = powerUps[i];
110:       const dx = ship.x - p.x, dy = ship.y - p.y;
111:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < ship.size + p.size) {
112: slowTimer = 3; // seconds
113:           // play power‑up sound
114:           sounds.powerUp.currentTime = 0;
115:           sounds.powerUp.play();
116:           powerUps.splice(i, 1);
117:         }
118:       }
119:     }
120: 
121:     // timer
122:     timeLeft -= dt / 1000;
123:     if (timeLeft <= 0) timeLeft = 0;
124: 
125:     // collision detection
126:     for (const o of obstacles) {
127:       const dx = ship.x - o.x, dy = ship.y - o.y;
128:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < ship.size + o.size / 2) {
129:         // Game over – reload page for simplicity
130: sounds.collision.currentTime = 0;
131:           sounds.collision.play();
132:           alert('Game Over');
133:           document.location.reload();
134:       }
135:     }
136: 
137:     // update slow timer
138:     if (slowTimer > 0) slowTimer -= dt / 1000;
139:   }
140: 
141:   function draw() {
142:     // Clear with semi‑transparent overlay for motion blur effect
143:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)';
144:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
145: 
146:     // Neon gradient background
147:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, width, height);
148:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
149:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#002');
150:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
151:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
152: 
153:     // Draw obstacles with neon glow
154:     ctx.save();
155:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
156:       ctx.translate(o.x, o.y);
157:       ctx.rotate(o.angle);
158:       ctx.shadowColor = '#f0f';
159:       ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
160:       ctx.fillStyle = '#e0e';
161:       ctx.fillRect(-o.size / 2, -o.size / 2, o.size, o.size);
162:       ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
163:     });
164:     ctx.restore();
165: 
166:     // Power‑ups with pulsating glow
167:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
168:       const hue = (performance.now() / 100) % 360;
169:       ctx.shadowColor = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
170:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
171:       ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 70%)`;
172:       ctx.beginPath();
173:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
174:       ctx.fill();
175:     });
176: 
177:     // Ship with neon outline
178:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
179:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
180:     ship.draw();
181:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset for UI
182: 
183:     // UI timer with neon text
184:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
185:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
186:     ctx.fillText('Time: ' + timeLeft.toFixed(1), 10, 20);
187:   }
188: 
189:   // Main loop
190:   function loop(now) {
191:     const dt = now - lastTime;
192:     lastTime = now;
193:     update(dt);
194:     draw();
195:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196:   }
197: 
198:   // Spawn intervals
199:   setInterval(spawnObstacle, obstacleFreq);
200:   setInterval(spawnPowerUp, powerUpFreq);
201: 
202:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
203: })();

(End of file - total 203 lines)
</content>
